title: Partly-installed model strands its weights: GC protects them, no Uninstall button
description: Lose one common dep and the model keeps exclusive evidence, so _localSharedDepsMap protects its whole universe and the orphan sweep skips it - while anyInstalled goes false and the card shows Install, never Uninstall. Bytes are held and unreachable. Reproducible today with one root.

attention.reason: Implementation done, pushed as cf28a816, and proven in a sandboxed isolated app (Boogu at 66% on disk offered Remove files and reclaimed the 19.17GB weight). Waiting on Fabio to confirm the affordance reads right in his own session.
